cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The table can float while we pack. That wet cup needs a mat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's at the ceiling. I'll pull it down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Wait! You'll slide the cup across the polish. Get the stepladder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll climb up. I've still got my muddy boots on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Boots off! Socks too if they're damp. We are not adding footprints to that water ring.

mechanism: A copies a whistle as controlling floating furniture and covers the error while escalating concern about wet polish and dirt.
confusable: D165 calmly accepts impossible danger but alarms over ordinary damage; D164 celebrates failures as benefits.
comparison: Formal dragon tea versus cooperative packing and care for furniture.
seedUse: Keep B solution of climbing as the cause of mud concern; clarify no need to stand on the table.
